title: A/R Summary: the Location chip reads all, a count, one name or none
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open A/R documents at three locations, {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}; {Location-C}'s name is longer than the chip can show.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310 and {Location-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-13 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Service Centre.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Location chip.
  2. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  3. Untick {Location-A}.
  4. Untick {Location-C}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Location: All locations".
  • Step 2: "Location: 2 locations".
  • Step 3: the chip shows {Location-C}'s name, shortened with "..." because it is long.
  • Step 4: "Location: No locations".

Whether the one-name chip also says "Location: " (question 10) and from what length a name is shortened (question 11) are asked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”
